subject: ICT
title: Whose Shadow?
subtitle: Match the picture to its shadow
hero_picture: A playful orange cat holding a crayon beside a row of animals (lion, rooster, goat, dog) and their black shadows, a girl pointing at toy trains.

sections.heading: Animals and shadows
text: Look at the lion, the rooster, the goat and the dog.
Each one has a dark shadow.
sections.caption: Animals and their shadows
sections.picture: A lion, a rooster, a goat and a dog standing in a row with their black shadows beside them on a sunny day.

sections.heading: My shadow
text: Stand in the sun and look down.
It has your shape, but it is dark.
sections.caption: My own shadow
sections.picture: A girl standing in the sun with her own dark shadow stretched on the ground beside her.

sections.heading: Match the shape
text: 'I will do this,' says the cat.
The rooster shadow has a comb and a tail.
Match the rooster to its shadow.
sections.caption: Matching a shadow
sections.picture: A black shadow shape of a rooster next to a colourful rooster, a child drawing a line to match them.

sections.heading: Baby puzzle game
text: A shadow of a toy train is shown.
Drag each piece and place it on its shadow.
sections.caption: Placing pieces on shadows
sections.picture: A laptop screen with a grey shadow of a toy train and colourful toy train pieces above it waiting to be placed.

sections.heading: Shadow play
text: Shine a torch on the wall.
Make a bird or a dog with your hands.
sections.caption: Hand shadows
sections.picture: Children making hand-shadow animals on a wall with a torch: a bird and a dog shape.

rhyme: Same in shape but dark as night,
Match them all, you got it right!
activity: Stand in the sun in the morning and at noon. Is your shadow long or short each time?
talk: How did the cat find the rooster's shadow?
What shadow can you make with your hands?
summary: A shadow has the same shape as the thing; we match each thing to its shadow.

questions.prompt: A shadow has the same ____ as the thing.
In 'Baby puzzle', where do we place each piece?
questions.explanation: Each piece goes on its own shadow.

questions.prompt: Which animal's shadow has a comb and a tail feather?
questions.explanation: A rooster has a comb and tail feathers.
